# T03 — Grid convergence and speed sensitivity

TinyFish search/fetch, 2026-11-01; no CFD solve, browser or visual QA.

- [NASA/NPARC grid convergence](https://www.grc.nasa.gov/www/wind/valid/tutorial/spatconv.html): Richardson extrapolation, safety factor 1.25 for three grids, effective refinement from cell counts and the worked pressure-recovery example. Tests reproduce p=1.786170, extrapolated value 0.97130, GCI=0.103083% and asymptotic ratio=1.002019. This is a mathematical fixture, not Veloira CFD.
- [Celik et al., 2008](https://doi.org/10.1115/1.2960953): requested reference. TinyFish returned bot_blocked at DOI; publisher PDF and NRC-hosted editorial PDF were unreachable. A secondary mirror returned a challenge. Exact Table 1 verification is **not claimed**. Reviewer should supply/check that original table.
- [Publisher PDF](https://asmedigitalcollection.asme.org/fluidsengineering/article-pdf/130/7/078001/5491455/078001_1.pdf), [NRC copy](https://www.nrc.gov/docs/ML0907/ML090780152.pdf): retrieval attempts documented; native web fallback also returned 403 for NRC.

## Visual reference
- NASA/NPARC source above: plot a numerical quantity against resolution with a distinct extrapolated estimate, retaining actual data points and uncertainty. This is a chart composition reference; no remote image is embedded.

## Method decisions
- Plan background-cell ratios of 1.5, but compute reporting GCI with effective three-dimensional spacing N^(-1/3), because snappy meshes need not achieve the planned cell-count ratio exactly. The general unequal-ratio Richardson equation is solved for positive p. Nonmonotonic or unsupported differences do not yield a fabricated order.
- Pin domain rounding to the fine case so changing base mesh spacing does not change physical domain extent. Other solver/refinement settings remain equal within each selected fidelity.
- Speed fit uses log(Re), residual uncertainty and a conservative floor from the declared Cd mean intervals. A zero-compatible slope means an effect was not resolved, not proof of Reynolds-number invariance.
- Pending-review cases may produce a conditional numerical report only when their mesh/mean gates pass; rejected cases are displayed diagnostically and excluded from GCI/speed inference. Physical validation is separate.
